name: starship
description: Installs the starship cross-shell prompt and configures the bash hook for all users, on both Debian/Ubuntu (/etc/bash.bashrc) and RPM distros (/etc/profile.d)

version.description: Version of starship to install. "latest" resolves the newest stable tag at build time; give an exact version to pin.

installShellHook.description: Add 'eval "$(starship init bash)"' to the system shell startup file. Turn this off if a dotfiles repo initialises starship itself.
